grandMA3 Object Tree

Browse grandMA3 onPC 2.5.1.0 by class, with live-verified Lua and command-line addresses, properties, creation examples and reference libraries.

Properties. Selecting a row lists the properties of that object class (the names you read and set), their type, whether they are read-only, and for option lists every value they accept. grandMA2 gives property names and the kind of value seen; its option lists are not exposed by the console, so instead each property shows one example value to show the format. grandMA2 rows also give the command-line form that reaches the object (each one checked on onPC by changing to it with cd), the Assign parameters from the onPC help, and how its items are numbered; the Attribute node lists the whole attribute library. Search also matches property names and command-line forms.
Select a row to see its properties and the values each can take.
